data.longBusinessSummary: NTT DATA Group Corporation provides IT and business services worldwide. It offers application, cloud, CX and digital products, cybersecurity, data and intelligence, digital workplace, edge, enterprise application platforms, generative AI, data centers, networks services, sustainability services, and technology solutions. The company also provides consulting, industry solutions, business process services, and IT modernization and managed services. It serves automotive, healthcare, life sciences and pharma, banking and financial services, education and research, energy and utilities, manufacturing and consumer packaged goods, public sector, retail, telco, media, and technology, travel, transportation, and logistics, and insurance industries. The company was formerly known as NTT DATA Corporation and changed its name to NTT DATA Group Corporation in July 2023. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. NTT DATA Group Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation.
